team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Rebel's Banner-Hymn (R1): consuming 4 Sigils of Whispers (built by Normal/Charged hits) grants nearby party members ATK +20% for 12s. Normal ATK SPD +12% not modeled (non-combat). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
